vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: baoyu-post-to-weibo
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle implements Weibo post automation using high-risk system-level operations to bypass anti-bot measures. Specifically, `copy-to-clipboard.ts` and `paste-from-clipboard.ts` execute shell commands via PowerShell, AppleScript (osascript), and Linux utilities (xclip/xdotool) to manipulate the system clipboard and simulate real keystrokes. Additionally, `weibo-utils.ts` performs process inspection and termination (`ps aux`, `kill`) to manage Chrome instances. While these capabilities are plausibly required for the stated purpose of automating a complex web editor, the use of shell-based keystroke injection and process management constitutes a significant high-risk attack surface without built-in safeguards against malicious input paths.

llm.summary: The skill largely does what it claims (automating Weibo posts via a real Chrome instance), but it performs several sensitive actions (clipboard manipulation and simulated paste keystrokes, automatic killing/restarting of Chrome CDP instances, downloading remote images, and reading/writing files under your home) and it reads environment variables that are not declared — you should review and consent before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the code and scripts: the scripts automate real Chrome via CDP to publish Weibo posts and articles, convert Markdown to HTML, handle clipboard operations, and manage Chrome profiles. Required binaries (bun or npx) are appropriate for the TypeScript scripts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and scripts do things beyond simply 'posting text': they read EXTEND.md from project/user config paths, create and reuse a Chrome profile directory in your home, launch and may forcibly kill Chrome instances, copy images/HTML to the system clipboard, and send real paste keystrokes to the frontmost app. The article flow downloads remote images referenced in Markdown (HTTPS only). Some behaviors are expected for this capability, but they are sensitive and should be explicit to the user (especially clipboard/paste and automatic process termination).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with included scripts (no external installer). No network install or archive extraction is declared. Scripts spawn local commands and rely on system tools (swift, powershell, xclip, wl-copy, xdotool/ydotool, etc.), which is expected for cross-platform clipboard and input automation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill references optional environment variables in code (WEIBO_BROWSER_CHROME_PATH, BAOYU_CHROME_PROFILE_DIR / WEIBO_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR, WEIBO_BROWSER_DEBUG_PORT) but SKILL.md / registry metadata list no required env vars. These are reasonable as overrides, but they are not documented in the skill metadata. The skill also reads and writes files under the user's home (profile dir, EXTEND.md) — appropriate for its purpose but should be disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (good). The skill will create and reuse a Chrome profile directory under your user data directory by default, leaving persistent browsing state (cookies/sessions) on disk. It also may kill or reuse existing Chrome instances tied to that profile. These are reasonable for the feature but give the skill continued access to your browser session and stored state.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears to implement Weibo posting as described, but it performs several sensitive local actions you should understand before installing:

- Clipboard & paste: it will copy HTML/images to your system clipboard and send real paste keystrokes (Cmd/Ctrl+V) to the frontmost application — that can leak sensitive clipboard contents if something else is frontmost. Clear your clipboard of secrets before using.
- Chrome profile & process control: it creates/uses a Chrome profile directory under your home (persistent browsing state) and can forcibly kill or restart Chrome/CDP instances automatically. If you want isolation, set WEIBO_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR / BAOYU_CHROME_PROFILE_DIR to a dedicated path or run in a disposable VM/container.
- Network downloads: Markdown image references will be fetched over HTTPS (remote image download). The code refuses non-HTTPS, but it still makes outbound requests to arbitrary hosts referenced in your Markdown.
- Undeclared env vars: optional env vars (WEIBO_BROWSER_CHROME_PATH, WEIBO_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR, WEIBO_BROWSER_DEBUG_PORT) are used but not documented in the registry metadata; set them if you need control over binary/profile/port locations.

Recommendations before installing:
- Review the included scripts yourself (they are present) or have someone you trust review them.
- If you want to limit blast radius, run the skill in an isolated environment or configure a dedicated Chrome profile directory.
- Don’t run this skill when you have sensitive data in the clipboard or while other important apps are frontmost.
- If you’re uncomfortable with automatic process termination, modify the troubleshooting behavior to ask before killing Chrome or run manually.
